quality.protocol: NMS 3x3, top200, score>=0.01, map length>20; endpoint-swap invariant squared distance sum<10 on 128x128 coordinates; one-to-one greedy matches; continuous AP. Small York subset, not paper protocol.

profile.note: Separate profiling session after timing; counts show provider assignment, not kernel-only latency or INT8 arithmetic coverage

benchmark.protocol: One isolated process/session per variant/device; ORT 1.20.2, 4 intra/1 inter threads, sequential ALL, spinning disabled; 16 warmups then 5x16 timing samples; batch1; profile in separate session after timing/evaluation
benchmark.scope: Synchronous session.run, CPU NumPy IO includes H2D/D2H and API overhead; excludes load/preprocess/decode; CUDA TF32 disabled; 2GiB arena limit and heuristic cuDNN workspace policy

scope: Same frozen 54-image/772-sentence set used for runtime comparison; no new tuning or independent test-set claim
